headline_en: Put $200.00 into Kofi's RESP; it earns $40.00 of Canada Education Savings Grant.
headline_target: 200,00 $ versés dans le REEE de Kofi; cela rapporte 40,00 $ de Subvention canadienne pour l'épargne-études.
done: $200.00 from the household account to Kofi's RESP, as his guardian (simulated receipt: no real money moves in this demo).

Grant room: the basic CESG is 20% of $200.00, so $40.00, leaving $460.00 of this year's $500.00 room and $7,160.00 of the $7,200.00 lifetime maximum (canada.ca, Estimating amounts, fetched 2026-09-12). Carry-forward room and grant received so far are not on file, so they were taken as zero.
next_step_en: Your RESP provider requests the $40.00 CESG from the government when it receives the contribution; nothing else to do.
next_step_target: Votre fournisseur de REEE demande la SCEE de 40,00 $ au gouvernement à la réception de la cotisation; rien d'autre à faire.
